worldsmith.config.api_key.tooltip: Stored in plain text in config/worldsmith.json. For AWS Bedrock this is the access key id.
worldsmith.config.api_key.tooltip.env: Leave blank to read %s from the environment instead.
worldsmith.config.api_secret.tooltip: AWS Bedrock only: the secret access key.
worldsmith.config.base_url.tooltip: Leave blank to use the provider's default endpoint. Set this to point at a local or proxied server.
worldsmith.config.max_output_tokens.tool: An upper bound on one reply. A whole biome plan needs several thousand.
worldsmith.config.mcp.about: Lets an external assistant read and write Worldsmith packs while the game is running. It listens on this machine only and is never reachable from the network.
worldsmith.config.mcp.autoApprove.toolti: On by default: a connected assistant may compile and run its own Java for this world without a confirmation. The worker limits time and memory, but it is not a filesystem or network sandbox and the code runs under your account. Turn this off to be asked once per authoring session.
worldsmith.config.mcp.discovery: Running bridges announce themselves in %s, so an agent can read the address from there instead of being told it. The file disappears when the bridge stops.
worldsmith.config.mcp.enabled.tooltip: Off by default. Turning this on opens a local port for as long as the game is running.
worldsmith.config.mcp.port.tooltip: The port to prefer. If it is busy the bridge takes the next free one, so the address below is what actually bound. The bridge restarts when you save.
worldsmith.config.model.tooltip: Leave blank to use the provider's default model.
worldsmith.config.provider.tooltip: Which API to speak. OPENAI_COMPATIBLE covers Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, DeepSeek and OpenRouter.
worldsmith.config.region.tooltip: AWS Bedrock only. Ignored by every other provider.
worldsmith.config.timeout_seconds.toolti: Seconds to wait for one reply before giving up.

worldsmith.creative.blocked_spawn: This creature needs a clear, permitted position with enough room for its body.
worldsmith.creative.creative_only: Worldsmith creature summoners require Creative mode.
worldsmith.creative.missing_species: This summoner does not reference a creature defined in this world.
worldsmith.creative.spawn_unavailable: This creature is unavailable under the current world settings or difficulty.
worldsmith.creative.wrong_world: This summoner belongs to a different world. Take a fresh one from this world's Worldsmith tab.
worldsmith.draw.approval.body: Session %s will run AI-authored Java in a separate process under your account. Time and memory are limited, but this is not a filesystem/network sandbox. Approve only a trusted AI client. Approval ends when the client restarts.
worldsmith.draw.approval.title: Allow AI Java authoring for this world?
worldsmith.extension.approval.title: Install trusted ability extension?
worldsmith.extension.approval.warning: Trusted JVM code: after restart it can access game APIs, files and network. It is not sandboxed or limited by AbilityScript's instruction budget.
worldsmith.extension.approval.static_onl: Only compilation and static ABI were checked. Provider constructors, static initializers, spec() and invoke() have not run.
worldsmith.extension.approval.independen: This confirmation is independent of drawing/session approval. Review the exact hashes and source before installing.
worldsmith.extension.approval.new_instal: New installation; no existing provider JAR is replaced.
worldsmith.extension.approval.restart: Installation only copies the approved JAR and receipt. Restart the game to load it; running worlds are not changed.
worldsmith.extension.approval.scroll: Scroll or use Page Up/Down to review every hash and provider. Escape declines installation.

worldsmith.progress.issues_more: More diagnostics are available in the generation-progress tool response.

worldsmith.mechanics.guide.title: Mechanism guide
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.open_hint: Read unlocked goals before building. Switch between this quest's mechanisms inside the guide.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.inspect_hint: Aim at the anchor before opening the journal. This reads the site once; it changes no blocks, items or progress.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.aim: Close the journal, aim at the anchor block, then reopen this guide.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.channel_unava: Site inspection is not connected yet. The building plan remains available.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.timeout: The inspection timed out. No activation was requested; press Inspect to try again.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.inspection_ru: This result refers to operation %s. It is a one-time snapshot, not a live monitor.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.orientation: Top view. Anchor = (0,0,0). +X east/right, +Z south/down; north is up. Coordinates are (X,Y,Z) relative to the same anchor on every layer.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.rotation_allo: This is the north-up base plan. The whole pattern, including block facings, may rotate 90°, 180° or 270° around the anchor.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.rotation_fixe: Fixed orientation: build with north up, exactly as shown.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.legend: Number/letter = palette block; . = required air; blank = unchecked. Gold cell = consumed; gold outline = anchor at Y=0. Row labels are Z, column labels are X.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.cell_list: Compact view: each required cell is listed below. Other positions are unchecked.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.no_blocks: No solid blocks are required; keep the marked air cells empty.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.material_note: These are counts in the finished pattern, not extra inventory costs. Consumed cells disappear on activation; replacement effects do not return the old block.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.use_block: With the pattern complete, use the anchor block at (0,0,0) with your main hand. Do not sneak.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.block_placed: Complete the pattern by placing its last required block; successful placement triggers this operation.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.empty_hand: Use the anchor with an empty main hand; no item is consumed.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.hand_cost: Hold %s ×%s in your main hand. This amount is consumed separately from the placed blocks.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.state_transit: Required state: %s → result: %s. New anchors start at %s.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.cooldown: After success: wait %s seconds before another eligible operation at this anchor.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.readonly: This guide reads the active world's saved rules, even offline and before the pattern is finished. Site inspection is optional and never activates anything.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.scroll: Scroll / Page Up or Down / Home or End. Esc returns to the journal; the journal key closes both.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.run_program: Begin %s after this device activates; its effects may continue over time.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.spawn: Summon %s at %s; leave room around that position.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.replace: Replace the block at %s with %s; the old block is not returned.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.ready: Ready. Perform the operation described in this guide.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.incomple: Pattern incomplete: %s cells differ from the plan.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.wrong_it: Follow the main-hand instruction in the guide; empty-hand operations require an empty main hand.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.insuffic: The main-hand cost is %s; you are holding %s.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.cooldown: This anchor is cooling down: %s seconds remaining.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.spent: This anchor has already changed state; this operation is no longer available here.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.wrong_bi: This operation requires a different biome.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.no_space: Make room in your main inventory for the reward.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.obstruct: A changed block or summoned creature would be obstructed. Clear room at the effect positions.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.protecte: This location is protected from the operation.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.unloaded: Part of this pattern is not loaded. Move closer before inspecting again.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.wrong_an: Aim at the anchor block shown at (0,0,0), not another pattern cell.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.instance: This world's mechanism instance limit has been reached.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.quaranti: Mechanism history needs repair; activation is paused to protect saved progress.
worldsmith.mechanics.inspection.unavaila: This mechanism is not available at this site right now.
worldsmith.mechanics.guide.specific_air: Special air at %s: %s. Ordinary cleared space is different.
